A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the first photonic crystal based sensor with a minimum detectable concentration of 1 x 108 molecules.
we have demonstrated that slow light in two dimensional Photonic crystals can provide an opportunity for significant reduction in the detection limit for chemical sensing and biosensing.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the sensitivity of the device is determined by the product of the quality factor and the group index.
the sensitivity of photonic crystal micro-cavities can be significantly enhanced by optimizing the group index of the cavity mode.
slow light in two dimensional silicon photonic crystal waveguides can be used to achieve the detection limit below the 1 x 107 RIU.
